subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 2: /v/ (vet, van, vat); sound differentiation; claps syllables in story words

show.line: Listen. v, v, van. Your lip buzzes! Van starts with v.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with v, as in van?
Say the sound with me. v, as in van!
Is it v or f? Listen. Vat.
Listen. v, e, t. What word is it?
Does it start with v or f? Sort the pictures.

hints: Top teeth on your lip and buzz. v, v, v.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with v.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Fan starts with f. Van starts with v.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. v, v, van. Van starts with v!

parent_line: Can hear the v sound and tell it apart from f.
